text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting North York Community Council to authorize the installation of pedestrian traffic control signals on Doris Avenue near Princess Avenue and all-way stop control at the intersection of Kenneth Avenue and Princess Avenue. The installation of traffic control signals and all-way stop control at these intersections is technically justified and will enhance safety for students walking to/from Earl Haig Secondary School. The new traffic control signals on Doris Avenue will operate so as to minimize delays for both pedestrians crossing Doris Avenue and north-south vehicular traffic.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of pedestrian traffic control signals on Doris Avenue at a point 90 metres south of Empress Avenue, in line with Princess Avenue. 2. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Kenneth Avenue and Princess Avenue.
